messages:
Marta: Quick shoutout — big thanks to @Ryan and the infra crew for the last-minute KV cache fix yesterday. Demo didn't melt down, and the tote bag idea was a winner :tada:
Ryan: haha thanks! Team effort. Special shout to @Priya for the late-night rollout checklist — that checklist is now officially my favorite doc. :sparkles:
Priya: Glad it worked. Also shoutout to @Lina for grabbing sandwiches and calming the demo team 😂 We should make 'snack calming' an official on-call skill.
Lina: Sandwiches = demo fuel. Also found 3 mystery tote bags in Conference Room B, left them on the big table with a sticky note. If you lost one, go check! :mag:
Sam: Can confirm demo saved. Also can someone add a "tote-bag duty" to the rota? :sweat_smile: I volunteer for weekend shifts (only if snacks included).
Marta: Also tiny ops note — ops-bot pinged at 02:13 with a KV shard evict, quick rollback did the trick. Log snippet below:
```
[ops-bot] 02:13:07 UTC - KV cache evicted shard-7 -> fallback hot-reload -> success
```
Thanks everyone for being on it. Seriously appreciate the late-night hustle. :heartpulse:
ops-bot: Incident cleared. Auto-note: incident#2026-074 filed. No pages, no followups required. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Treats on me for the next sprint demo — coffee + bagels? I'll post a quick poll in #lunch-plans.
Ryan: I'll bring the reusable mugs and the good thermos :coffee:
Sam: Love it. Huge thanks all — reminded why I love working with this team. :raised_hands:
